All securities issued under the offering are restricted from trading until February 27, 2027, and the financing closed October 26, 2026, the company said, giving Red Canyon fresh capital to advance exploration on its British Columbia projects.

brief: The United States and Canada are working on a deal to ease U.S. tariffs on Canadian steel and autos, Reuters reported, citing sources close to the talks. The negotiations follow the collapse of broader trade talks in August and focus on Section 232 duties of up to 50% on steel and 25% on autos.

U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and Canada's Dominic LeBlanc have been in regular contact, Reuters reported. Trump has said he would raise Canadian steel tariffs to 50% from January 1, 2027, absent a deal, and predicted at a rally that the dispute would be resolved "soon." One Canadian source said a deal was possible before the November 3 elections, while a separate source said any deal was likely to be narrower in scope.

No venture-market name in the tariffs theme traded today, so this publication reports no group measure and names nobody; the theme simply produced no trading today to compare against the broader board.

The deal adds roughly 266,000 net acres in the Montney's oil window, about 20,000 barrels of oil equivalent a day of current production, plus 420 net well locations, 220 of them premium return. The transaction is expected to close early in the first quarter of 2027, subject to Logan shareholder, court and regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. entries.headline: Canadian retail sales rose 1.2% in August
entries.dek: Statistics Canada said sales reached $74.6 billion, with gains in all nine retail subsectors and a preliminary estimate pointing to a 0.7% rise in September.
entries.caption: Shoppers move through a plaza at dusk, as Statistics Canada reports another month of broad-based retail gains.

sources.title: Retail trade, August 2026

brief: Statistics Canada said Canadian retail sales rose 1.2% to $74.6 billion in August, with sales increasing across all nine retail subsectors. Motor vehicle and parts dealers led the gain, also up 1.2%, while gasoline stations rose 1.7% and food and beverage retailers increased 1.1%, their first gain in three months.

Core retail sales, which exclude gasoline stations and motor vehicle and parts dealers, rose 1.1%. In volume terms, which adjust for price changes, sales were also up 1.2%. E-commerce sales totalled $5.6 billion, an increase of 1.1%, representing 7.6% of total retail trade for the month, the agency said.

Ontario led provincial gains, up 2.2% to $28.5 billion, followed by British Columbia, up 2.1% to $10.0 billion. Sales declined in Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island, New Brunswick, Alberta, Yukon and Nunavut, by 0.1% to 0.6%. A preliminary estimate for September points to a 0.7% increase, the agency said.

entries.headline: Fewer young women meet activity guidelines, Statistics Canada reports
entries.dek: Statistics Canada's October Health Reports found that 46% of Canadian adults met weekly activity guidelines, with activity trends diverging by age and sex.
entries.caption: Statistics Canada's October Health Reports tracked physical-activity trends among Canadian adults from 2007 to 2024, measured by accelerometer.

sources.title: Health Reports, October 2026

brief: Statistics Canada reported in its October 2026 Health Reports that 46% of Canadian adults met the recommendation of at least 150 minutes of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity per week, using accelerometer-measured data from the Canadian Health Measures Survey. The agency said the share of men aged 18 to 39 meeting the recommendation held stable at 65% from 2007 to 2024.

Over the same period, the share of women aged 18 to 39 meeting the recommendation fell from 52% to 43%, Statistics Canada said. Adults aged 60 to 79 moved the other way, with the share meeting the recommendation rising nine percentage points for both sexes between 2007 and 2024.

The agency also reported that from 2022 to 2024, 34% of women aged 18 to 39 needed only 5 to 10 more daily minutes to meet the recommendation, while 50% of women aged 60 to 79 logged under 10 qualifying minutes a day. About a third of adults recorded at least 7,500 steps daily over the period.

entries.headline: Canada's CPI rises 3.1% in September on energy prices
entries.dek: Statistics Canada said energy and gasoline prices drove the acceleration from August's 3.0% annual pace, even as food inflation eased to its slowest pace since mid-2024.
entries.caption: Statistics Canada reported the Consumer Price Index rose 3.1% year over year in September 2026, driven mainly by gasoline and energy prices.

sources.title: Consumer Price Index, September 2026

brief: Statistics Canada said the Consumer Price Index rose 3.1% year over year in September, up from a 3.0% increase in August. On a monthly basis, the index rose 0.1% unadjusted, or 0.4% on a seasonally adjusted basis.

The agency said energy prices led the acceleration, with crude oil increasing in September to its highest level since May "amid ongoing uncertainty about the wars in the Middle East." Gasoline prices rose 27.8% year over year, up from 22.8% in August. Excluding gasoline, the CPI rose 2.2%, down from 2.4% the prior month.

Statistics Canada said food purchased from stores rose 1.7% year over year, the smallest increase since May 2024, while shelter costs rose 1.8%, up from 1.5% in August, which it tied to higher fuel oil costs and homeowners' insurance. The agency said five provinces saw faster price growth, mostly tied to gasoline and fuel oil costs.

brief: Statistics Canada said wholesale sales, excluding petroleum, petroleum products, other hydrocarbons, oilseed and grain, fell 1.6% to $91.6 billion in August 2026. Sales decreased in five of seven subsectors, representing 70.6% of total wholesale sales, led by a 3.8% decline to $15.1 billion in the motor vehicle and motor vehicle parts and accessories subsector.

The decline was moderated by a 1.4% increase to $14.1 billion in the building material and supplies subsector. Agricultural supplies posted the next-largest decrease, down 12.4% to $3.5 billion. Wholesale sales were 7.2% higher than in August of the prior year, though in volume terms sales fell 1.8% on the month.

Wholesale inventories, under the same exclusions, were unchanged in August at $141.0 billion, and the inventory-to-sales ratio rose from 1.51 in July to 1.54 in August. Statistics Canada said the release's content was produced with the assistance of a generative AI tool and verified by its own experts.

brief: Statistics Canada published the Sector-based Producer Price Indexes for the first time on October 9, 2026, for the second quarter of 2026. The agency said the indexes measure price changes across four broad producer sectors: energy, non-energy, goods and services.

sources.title: Labour Force Survey, September 2026

brief: Statistics Canada said employment fell by 68,000, or 0.3%, in September, with the reference period covering September 13 to 19, 2026. The unemployment rate rose 0.1 percentage points to 6.5%, and the employment rate fell 0.2 percentage points to 60.6%, the agency said in its Labour Force Survey.

The agency said full-time employment declined by 35,000, or 0.2%, while part-time employment fell by 33,000, or 0.9%. Among industries, Statistics Canada reported declines in educational services (-35,000), health care and social assistance (-23,000) and manufacturing (-13,000), and growth in other services such as repair, maintenance and personal services (+17,000).

Statistics Canada said average hourly wages among employees rose 2.3% year over year, up 86 cents to $37.64. The agency reported declines in employment in Quebec, British Columbia and Manitoba, and increases in Alberta, Newfoundland and Labrador, and Prince Edward Island. Public sector employment fell for a fourth consecutive month, the agency said.

Under an assignment and assumption of property option agreement dated September 25, 2026, with Bathurst Metals Corp. and Stanley R McClay, as bare trustee for BCT Holdings Corp., Big Bear will acquire Bathurst's 100% optioned interest in the Peerless Property in the Bridge River Mining Camp, British Columbia.

The notice does not restate the transaction's terms: it says full details are set out in the company's news release dated October 1, 2026, and this entry draws only on the notice. The transaction remains subject to TSXV approval, and the notice gives no closing date.

entries.headline: Elton Resources begins TSX Venture trading and grants 12.7 million options
entries.dek: The former Chicane Capital I Corp. opened under the symbol DBAY on October 6, engaged ICP Securities Inc. for market-making and granted options exercisable at $0.20 for 10 years.
entries.caption: Elton Resources, formerly Chicane Capital I Corp., began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange with its Darnley Bay Project in the Northwest Territories.

sources.title: Elton Resources Announces Commencement of Trading on The TSXV
Elton Resources (TSXV: DBAY) Commences Trading on TSX Venture, Advances Darnley Bay Nickel-Copper-PGE Exploration

unverified_claims: That the Darnley Bay anomaly is one of the strongest isolated gravity anomalies in the world and is prospective for nickel-copper-platinum group elements, as the company states.
That the anomaly's source has drawn favourable comparisons to Sudbury, Noril'sk and the Bushveld Complex, as the release states.
That the 2018 magnetotelluric survey identified several targets (over ten large-scale targets, in the chief executive's words).
That the company will carry out a drilling program, which it says it plans.
brief: Elton Resources Corp. (TSXV: DBAY), formerly Chicane Capital I Corp., said its common shares began trading on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol DBAY at market open on October 6, 2026. The company is focused on its flagship Darnley Bay Project in the Northwest Territories, where it says the anomaly is considered prospective for nickel-copper-platinum group elements.

The company granted 12,720,378 incentive stock options under its equity incentive plan to eligible participants, including certain directors, officers and consultants. Each is exercisable for one common share at $0.20 for 10 years and vests immediately. It also engaged Toronto-based ICP Securities Inc. for automated market-making at C$7,500 a month, plus applicable taxes, from October 1, 2026.

The release does not state the number of shares outstanding, so the option grant cannot be measured against the share count from this disclosure. The market-making agreement has no performance factors and, beyond the monthly fee, no options or other compensation; ICP bears its own trading costs, and no third party is providing funds or securities.

entries.headline: StrikePoint sets ten-for-one consolidation ahead of Northumberland closing
entries.dek: The company expects to close its purchase of the Nevada gold project from Newmont subsidiaries on or about October 6, with about C$90 million in cash.
entries.caption: A Nevada gold project idle for more than 15 years is scheduled to change hands on or about October 6.

sources.title: StrikePoint Gold Announces October 2 Share Consolidation and October 6 Northumberland Acquisition Closing with C$90M Cash Backing

unverified_claims: StrikePoint's expectation that the Northumberland acquisition will close on or about October 6, 2026.
The company's expectation of approximately C$90 million in cash after closing.
The estimated share counts of about 7,239,238 after consolidation and about 102.2 million after conversion of the subscription receipts.
The company's statement that the amended technical report contains no material changes.
The planned use of cash for resource expansion, infill drilling and technical, economic and environmental studies.
brief: StrikePoint Gold Inc. (TSXV: SKP) will consolidate its shares, options and warrants on a ten-for-one basis effective October 2, 2026, leaving about 7,239,238 common shares outstanding. The company said it expects to close its acquisition of the Northumberland Gold Project in Nevada from subsidiaries of Newmont Corporation on or about October 6.

Closing releases the proceeds of a $190 million bought deal of subscription receipts completed to fund the purchase. After closing, the company expects roughly C$90 million in cash and, once the receipts convert, about 102.2 million shares outstanding. The shares remain halted pending final TSX Venture Exchange approval and completion of the transaction.

The two share counts matter most to existing holders: the register as it stands will be a small fraction of the enlarged company once the receipts convert. The receipt structure ties the money to the deal, since the proceeds are released on closing, so the financing and the purchase complete together.

entries.headline: ATERRA Metals launches brokered LIFE offering for up to $6 million
entries.dek: Research Capital leads the best-efforts sale of common shares at $0.06 to fund Phase II work at the Totora copper-gold project in Chile, following a maiden resource estimate.
entries.caption: A Chilean copper-gold project with a newly announced maiden Inferred resource is the focus of a brokered share offering.

sources.title: ATERRA Metals Initiates Brokered Private Placement to Secure Up to $6 Million for Chile Copper-Gold Exploration

unverified_claims: The maiden Inferred Mineral Resource estimate for Totora of 159.8 million tonnes at 0.51% copper equivalent (0.30% copper, 0.15 g/t gold) at a 0.2% copper cut-off, as announced by the company.
The offering size and the expected closing on or about October 14, 2026, which depend on demand under a best-efforts mandate and on CSE conditional approval.
The planned use of proceeds for Phase II exploration at Totora.
brief: ATERRA Metals Inc. (CSE: ATC) has engaged Research Capital Corporation as lead agent and sole bookrunner for a brokered, best-efforts private placement of common shares at $0.06, for gross proceeds of $4 million to $6 million. The agents may increase the offering by up to 15% of the shares sold. Closing is targeted for on or about October 14, 2026.

The shares are offered in all provinces except Quebec and in qualifying jurisdictions including the United States, under the listed issuer financing exemption, and are free-trading on closing. Agents receive a 6.0% cash commission and broker warrants for 6.0% of shares sold, exercisable at $0.06 for 24 months. CSE conditional approval is required.

Proceeds go to Phase II exploration at Totora, in Chile's Region III, where ATERRA announced a maiden Inferred resource of 159.8 million tonnes at 0.51% copper equivalent on September 24. Raising on the back of a first resource is a familiar sequence; at six cents, the final share count is the figure to watch.

entries.headline: TempraMed upsizes CSE placement to C$1.6 million of debentures and units
entries.dek: The CSE-listed medical-device company now seeks up to C$600,000 in 10% unsecured convertible debentures and up to C$1,000,000 in units, with each unit carrying a C$1.00 warrant.
entries.caption: TempraMed's upsized offering pairs 10% convertible debentures with units carrying C$1.00 warrants, subject to Canadian Securities Exchange approval.

sources.title: TempraMed Technologies Boosts Private Placement to C$1.6 Million Featuring Convertible Debentures and Warrants

unverified_claims: The description of TempraMed's devices as patented, FDA-registered and operating without batteries or external power is the company's own.
The company's reported operations in North America, Europe and Asia and its four in-market products are as stated by the company.
The intended use of proceeds is as stated by the company; the offering has not closed, remains subject to CSE approval, and the amounts are maximums.
brief: TempraMed Technologies Ltd. (CSE:VIVI) said on September 28 it has upsized the non-brokered private placement it announced on September 23. The offering now comprises up to C$600,000 of unsecured convertible debentures and up to C$1,000,000 of units, for aggregate gross proceeds of up to C$1,600,000. Each unit is one share and one warrant.

The debentures pay 10% a year, calculated monthly and paid quarterly in cash, mature after one year and convert at $0.50 a share. Each warrant buys a further share at C$1.00 for 18 months after closing. The offering needs CSE approval, and all securities carry a four-month-and-one-day hold.

The release does not state the unit price, so the relationship between the $0.50 conversion price, the C$1.00 warrant and the price at which units are sold cannot be read from this disclosure. For a device company, pairing debt with equity defers part of the dilution while fixing the price at which that debt would convert.

entries.headline: Rare-earth magnet maker Evolution Metals added to Russell indexes
entries.dek: The Nasdaq-listed critical-materials company joined the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 at the September 21 open through FTSE Russell's quarterly additions.
entries.caption: The floor of an advanced manufacturing plant, the kind of facility Western critical-materials producers are racing to scale.

sources.title: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. Joins Russell 3000® and Russell 2000® Indexes, Gaining Exposure to $12.2 Trillion in Benchmarked Assets

unverified_claims: The fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of US$400-460 million, the ~10,000 metric ton capacity target, the 6,000 metric ton magnet capacity, the 750-megawatt KEPCO agreement and the November 2026 ULVAC equipment delivery are all company guidance or forward targets, not audited or independently verified figures.
The company's self-description as a commercial-scale rare-earth permanent magnet producer rests on its own statement.
brief: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. joined the Russell 3000 and Russell 2000 indexes at the opening of US trading on September 21, the company said, added through FTSE Russell's third-quarter 2026 quarterly process for recent listings. FTSE Russell reports that roughly US$12.2 trillion is benchmarked to or invested in its US index products.

The Nasdaq-listed company describes itself as a US producer of rare-earth permanent magnets, battery materials and related critical minerals. It said it is guiding to fiscal 2027 revenue of US$400 million to US$460 million and targeting about 10,000 metric tons of annual capacity, including 6,000 tons of sintered NdFeB magnets.

Quarterly index reconstitution draws passive funds tracking the benchmarks into every new constituent — a mechanical source of demand independent of the company's operations. For a recently listed critical-materials name, the addition widens institutional ownership. The production and revenue targets behind it, however, remain the company's own unaudited projections.

entries.headline: Left Field to combine with Kilroy Metal in TSXV qualifying transaction
entries.dek: The capital pool company will acquire an early-stage Arizona copper-gold-silver project and raise up to C$6 million in subscription receipts, then relist as Kilroy Metal Inc.
entries.caption: Brownfield mining ground in the American Southwest, the kind of asset TSXV shells increasingly pursue.

sources.title: Left Field Capital Corp. Finalizes Agreement with Kilroy Metal for TSXV Qualifying Transaction and Announces Up to C$6 Million Private Placement

unverified_claims: Historical copper, gold and silver production at the Crown King Road Project, per the release.
The project comprising 3,636 contiguous acres of patented land and mining claims, per the company.
Completion of the qualifying transaction and the concurrent financing remain subject to TSXV approval and stated conditions, per the release.
brief: Left Field Capital Corp. (TSXV: LFC.P), a capital pool company, signed a definitive business combination agreement dated September 18 with Kilroy Metal, Inc. to complete its qualifying transaction. The combined company would be renamed Kilroy Metal Inc. and pursue a TSX Venture Exchange listing.

The deal is structured as a three-cornered amalgamation. Alongside it, the parties launched a non-brokered private placement of subscription receipts at C$0.45 each, seeking C$5 million to C$6 million. Receipts carry a warrant exercisable at C$0.65 for 24 months, with closing expected around September 30.

The asset is the Crown King Road Project in Yavapai County, Arizona, described as brownfield ground with historical copper, gold and silver production. LFC.P shares remain halted pending completion. The structure is the standard route by which a listed shell recycles cash into an early-stage mining vehicle.

entries.headline: Battery X Metals files fifth amended F-1 for US IPO
entries.dek: The Vancouver battery-metals and battery-technology company has made its fifth confidential draft submission to the SEC as it works toward a US listing.

The patent-pending status and National Research Council collaboration, per the company.
The dates of the four prior confidential amendments and the initial December 12, 2025 filing, as stated in the release.
brief: Battery X Metals Inc. (CSE: BATX) submitted a fifth amended draft registration statement on Form F-1 to the US Securities and Exchange Commission, effective September 8, 2026, as it pursues an initial public offering on a US national securities exchange.

The confidential submission is the fifth since the company's initial SEC filing on December 12, 2025. The proposed offering price and number of shares remain undecided, and the release states completion depends on SEC review and market conditions. The filing was made under Rule 135 and is not itself an offer.

Battery X describes itself as an energy-transition resource exploration and technology firm, working on battery-metal exploration and lithium-ion battery lifespan and recovery technology. A confidential draft is a negotiation with the regulator, not a launched deal; the count of amendments marks progress, not proximity to pricing.

entries.headline: Canagold closes C$7.1 million placement, Sun Valley rises to 49.75%
entries.dek: The financing for the New Polaris gold-antimony project in British Columbia lifted major insider Sun Valley Investments AG to just under half of Canagold's shares.
entries.caption: Junior gold developers increasingly lean on a single anchor shareholder to fund permitting.

sources.title: Canagold Resources Secures $7.1M in Private Placement to Boost New Polaris Gold-Antimony Project

unverified_claims: Sun Valley Investments AG's holdings and percentages (48.25% rising to 49.75%), per the company's disclosure.
Application of MI 61-101 exemptions on the basis that participation did not exceed 25% of market capitalisation, per the release.
New Polaris's advanced-stage status and permitting progress, per the company.
brief: Canagold Resources Ltd. (TSX: CCM) completed a C$7.1 million private placement of common and flow-through shares for its New Polaris gold-antimony project in northwestern British Columbia. Common shares were priced at C$0.47 and flow-through shares at C$0.52, with no finder's fees paid.

The company issued 5,319,149 common shares and 8,846,154 flow-through shares. Major shareholder Sun Valley Investments AG took 3,856,383 common and 6,413,462 flow-through shares, lifting its stake from 48.25% to 49.75%. The TSX granted conditional approval on September 8; final approval is pending.

The insider participation was reviewed under Multilateral Instrument 61-101, with exemptions applied because it did not exceed 25% of market capitalisation. A single holder near 50% concentrates control, a recurring feature of thinly financed developers advancing capital-intensive permitting. New Polaris remains in environmental assessment.

entries.headline: Noble Mineral to buy Lucas Township gold project from Canada Nickel for stock
entries.dek: The junior will pay 5 million units for the drill-ready Timmins-area property, and Canada Nickel keeps a back-in right to reclaim a quarter of it.
entries.caption: Boreal exploration country north of Timmins, where the Abitibi belt has yielded gold for over a century.

sources.title: Noble Mineral Exploration Secures Lucas Gold Project Near Timmins from Canada Nickel Company

unverified_claims: The historical figure of 'over 75 million ounces' for the Timmins camp is a regional statistic cited by the company and describes the district, not the property.
The 2018 drilling details (15 holes, 3,184 metres over ~650 metres of strike) and the count of untested IP trends rest on the company's disclosure.
The back-in right terms are as described in Noble's release and not independently verified.
brief: Noble Mineral Exploration has signed a purchase agreement to acquire the Lucas Township gold project from Canada Nickel Company, firming up a July letter of intent. Noble will issue 5,000,000 units at C$0.06 — one share plus half a warrant each — as consideration, subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.

Each whole warrant is exercisable at C$0.15 for two years. Canada Nickel keeps a back-in right to reclaim a 25% interest by paying Noble four times its exploration spend, exercisable at the earliest of 36 months, C$5 million of cumulative exploration, or a sale or change of control of Noble.

The property sits about 30 kilometres north of Timmins, a camp the company notes has produced over 75 million ounces of gold historically. For a junior, taking a drill-ready target from a larger explorer in exchange for paper conserves cash while handing the vendor equity and a claw-back on success.

entries.headline: Heritage Mining closes final placement tranche, taking total to C$2.6 million
entries.dek: The fourth and final tranche raised C$930,500 and was led by insiders and one institutional fund, funding critical-mineral exploration in Ontario.
entries.caption: Lakeland exploration ground in northwestern Ontario, the setting for critical-mineral flow-through programmes.

sources.title: Heritage Mining Secures $2.6 Million in Oversubscribed Private Placement, Final Tranche Led by Insiders

Insider subscription amounts (Peter Schloo/Great White Capital C$200,000; Ten Point Fund C$200,000; director Patrick Mohan) are as disclosed in the release.
The flow-through spending and renunciation deadlines, and the list of Ontario properties, rest on the company's statement.
brief: Heritage Mining has closed the fourth and final tranche of a non-brokered private placement, raising C$930,500 to bring the total across all four tranches to roughly C$2,600,500. The company described the final tranche as oversubscribed and led by insiders alongside institutional investors.

The tranche comprised 4,000,000 flow-through shares at C$0.04 and 19,262,500 units at C$0.04, each unit carrying one share and one warrant exercisable at C$0.05 until 16 September 2031. President and chief executive Peter Schloo subscribed C$200,000 through Great White Capital, matched by the Ten Point Fund.

Insider-led final tranches are a mixed signal: they show management willing to fund the company, but a raise that leans on insiders and a single fund can indicate thin outside demand. The flow-through structure ties part of the proceeds to Canadian critical-mineral exploration the company must incur by the end of 2027.

entries.headline: Homeland Nickel closes C$3.04 million placement, wins U.S. drill permit for Red Flat
entries.dek: The U.S. Forest Service approved a plan of operations for sonic drilling in Oregon as the company closed a non-brokered financing to fund the work.
entries.caption: Coastal mountains of southwest Oregon, where nickel-bearing ground sits under federally managed forest.

sources.title: Homeland Nickel Secures C$3.04M in Private Placement and Obtains USFS Approval for Red Flat Sonic Drilling

unverified_claims: The Forest Service Plan of Operations approval and the status of ongoing NEPA and cultural reviews are as described by the company.
The chief executive's aim to complete drilling by October is a company target contingent on crew availability, not a commitment.
The expected timing of the Cleopatra plan submission and Q4 2026 resource estimates are forward-looking company statements.
brief: Homeland Nickel paired two updates: it closed a non-brokered private placement raising C$3,040,000, and said the U.S. Forest Service has approved its plan of operations for a sonic drilling programme at the Red Flat nickel project in Oregon. Final TSX Venture Exchange approval of the placement is still pending.

The placement issued 8,000,000 units at C$0.38, each a share plus half a warrant exercisable at C$0.50 for two years, with insiders taking 465,098 units. On the permitting side, the company said federal environmental and cultural reviews remain ongoing even as fieldwork has begun.

Advancing a U.S. drill permit is the harder half of the story: federal-land nickel projects move slowly through Forest Service and environmental review, and reaching an approved plan of operations is a milestone many exploration juniors never clear. The financing supplies the cash to act on it.

entries.headline: City View Green restructures ArkenYield deal, adds up to US$2M financing
entries.dek: An amended agreement replaces the September 2025 acquisition with an amalgamation and a Finco subscription-receipt placement of up to US$2,000,000, leaving City View a 10% Newco holder.
entries.caption: A restructured acquisition routes a subsidiary-level placement into a digital-asset venture, with the raise capped and partly deferred to December.

sources.title: City View Green Updates ArkenYield Transaction with New Amalgamation and Up to $2M Financing

unverified_claims: The Elara total value locked of more than US$655,000 and the 14.74% quoted yield are figures attributed to ArkenYield and the product, not independently verified.
The transaction structure, cap table and financing terms are as disclosed in City View's release; the placement amount is a maximum and the deal remains to be completed.
brief: City View Green Holdings said it has signed an amended and restated securities purchase agreement, dated August 12, with ArkenYield Ltd., replacing the September 17, 2025 agreement entirely. The revised deal drops the earlier plan to buy 2,000,000 ArkenYield shares for 5,750,000 City View shares and a $287,500 debenture, substituting an amalgamation structure and a new financing.

ArkenYield continues into British Columbia; a subsidiary called Finco raises up to US$2,000,000 in subscription receipts and amalgamates with ArkenYield to form Amalco; and City View ends up with 1,000,000 Newco shares, or 10%. The founder group holds 90%. On closing, City View issues the Founder 2,500,000 shares and 2,500,000 warrants exercisable at $0.10 for three years, on a cashless basis.

The release pairs the restructuring with a commercial marker for ArkenYield, whose technology it says supports Elara, a stablecoin treasury product, with more than US$655,000 in total value locked as of August 17. A minimum US$400,000 of the financing must close by December 7. City View said CSE approval of the change of business is not required to complete the transaction.

entries.headline: Illumisoft names Agahi CEO, begins OTCQB trading, settles debt in shares
entries.dek: The photonic-disinfection company made its chairman chief executive, started U.S. OTCQB trading under FUVCF, and moved to settle C$413,764 of debt with stock.
entries.caption: A newly OTCQB-quoted disinfection-technology issuer consolidates its chair and chief-executive roles and settles payables in stock.

sources.title: Illumisoft Lighting Names Ehsan Agahi as CEO, Begins OTCQB Trading, and Settles C$413,764 Debt with Shares

unverified_claims: The leadership changes, OTCQB commencement, DTC application status and shares-for-debt terms are as disclosed in Illumisoft's release.
The description of the company's business and end markets is the company's own.
brief: Illumisoft Lighting Corp. said Ehsan Agahi became chief executive effective August 19 while remaining chairman, with former CEO Brett Nicholds moving to senior strategic advisor and staying a director. The same day its shares began trading on the U.S. OTCQB Venture Market under FUVCF, alongside its existing TSX Venture listing as UVC.

Illumisoft also proposed to settle C$413,764.12 of debt by issuing 646,506 common shares at a deemed C$0.64 — C$203,764.12 owed on two promissory notes and C$210,000 for consulting services, all to arm's-length parties. The settlement is subject to TSXV acceptance. The company has applied for full-service DTC eligibility, which it said is not assured.

For a micro-cap technology issuer, an OTCQB quotation widens U.S. retail access without the cost of a full exchange listing, and DTC eligibility, if granted, eases electronic settlement of its shares stateside. Paying advisers and noteholders in stock preserves cash — common for early-stage venture names — at the price of modest dilution.

entries.headline: Quimbaya grants 37 Capital option over Colombian Berrio project
entries.dek: The 12-month option could bring up to US$3.75 million in cash and shares while leaving Quimbaya an approximate 19.9% stake in the buyer and issuing no Quimbaya shares.
entries.caption: A junior options a peripheral Colombian licence for staged cash and shares, keeping a minority stake and issuing no new stock of its own.

sources.title: Quimbaya Gold Grants 37 Capital Exclusive Option to Acquire Non-Core Berrio Project for Up to $3.75M in Cash and Shares

unverified_claims: The option terms, deposit schedule, retained 19.9% stake and project description are as stated in Quimbaya's release.
Quimbaya's characterisation of the deal as non-dilutive and its expectation of Q3 2026 Tahami Center drill results are company statements.
brief: Quimbaya Gold has granted 37 Capital Inc. an exclusive, 12-month option to acquire its non-core Berrio project in Puerto Berrío, Antioquia, Colombia, for total consideration of up to US$3.75 million in cash and shares. The project comprises mining concession contract No. 6822, about 1,218.88 hectares, plus five related concession applications.

The structure is non-dilutive for Quimbaya: no Quimbaya shares are issued. 37 Capital pays two non-refundable deposits — US$100,000 then US$150,000, US$250,000 in aggregate — during the option period; on exercise it issues 7,600,000 of its shares at a deemed C$0.10 and pays the balance in cash. Quimbaya would retain an approximate 19.9% interest in 37 Capital. Closing needs CSE acceptance.

For a single-asset-focused explorer, the deal converts ground peripheral to its flagship Tahami project in the Segovia district into cash, shares and a minority stake in the acquirer, without diluting its own holders. It is the kind of housekeeping juniors reach for when direct equity raises are costly — monetising a non-core licence rather than selling stock.

entries.headline: Dryden Gold closes first tranche of Lost Lake option
entries.dek: The TSX Venture Exchange approved the Orebot option, letting Dryden issue its opening cash and shares toward a full interest in the 122-claim Northwestern Ontario property.
entries.caption: Staged option agreements let junior explorers assemble claim blocks in Ontario's historic gold camps while conserving cash.

sources.title: Dryden Gold Closes Option Agreement for Lost Lake Property
Dryden Gold Clarifies Number of Claims on Lost Lake Property

unverified_claims: The claim count, the staged cash-and-share consideration, the deemed price of $0.21, the four-month-and-one-day hold, and the 3% NSR royalty and buyback terms are as stated in the company's release.
brief: Dryden Gold has closed the initial tranche of its option to acquire a full interest in the Lost Lake Property, 122 claims in the Gold Rock Mining Camp of Northwestern Ontario. The step followed TSX Venture Exchange approval of the June 29 agreement with arm's-length vendor Orebot Inc.

The opening consideration was $10,000 in cash and 25,000 shares at a deemed $0.21, carrying a four-month-and-one-day hold. Two further payments follow: $40,000 and 50,000 shares on the first anniversary, and $50,000 and 50,000 shares on the second, to earn the 100% interest.

On completion, Orebot retains a 3% net smelter return royalty payable after commercial production, half of which Dryden may repurchase for $1 million. The staged structure — modest cash, most consideration in paper and time — is the standard way venture explorers add ground without straining treasury.

entries.headline: Benton, Metals Creek complete Newfoundland hydrogen-helium survey, add claims
entries.dek: The partners collected more than 700 soil-gas samples across two projects and jointly acquired ground from G2B Gold, with laboratory results expected within two weeks.
entries.caption: Soil-gas surveys are the first reconnaissance step in the search for naturally occurring hydrogen in sedimentary basins.

sources.title: Benton Resources and Metals Creek Finalize New Claim Acquisitions and Complete Extensive Hydrogen-Helium Soil Gas Survey in Newfoundland

unverified_claims: The sample count of more than 700, the target of naturally occurring hydrogen and helium, the two-week results timeline, and the G2B Gold acquisition terms (claim units, share consideration and 2% royalty) are as stated in the companies' release.
brief: Benton Resources and Metals Creek Resources have completed a soil-gas sampling program at their Smoking Gun and Parson's Pond projects in Newfoundland, collecting more than 700 samples targeting naturally occurring hydrogen and helium. The samples have gone to a Saskatoon laboratory, with results expected within about two weeks.

Alongside the survey, the two companies entered a purchase agreement with G2B Gold to jointly acquire, 50/50, a 100% interest in two mineral licences covering 30 claim units in the Deer Lake Basin. Consideration is 120,000 Metals Creek shares and 82,500 Benton shares, with G2B keeping a 2% net smelter royalty.

The programs sit within a small but growing effort to prove naturally occurring, or 'white,' hydrogen in Canadian sedimentary basins — a frontier the market is still learning to price. With no assay results yet reported, the announcement marks activity and land consolidation rather than discovery, and the two-week wait sets the next catalyst.

entries.headline: TempraMed signs definitive Panama distribution deal, ships first order
entries.dek: The temperature-protection device maker converted an earlier letter of intent with TEM Consulting into a binding exclusive agreement and completed an initial bulk order.
entries.caption: Temperature-protection devices aim to keep medications within safe temperatures without batteries or power.

sources.title: TempraMed Technologies Finalizes Exclusive Panama Distribution Agreement with TEM, Completes Initial Bulk Order

unverified_claims: That the VIVI devices are patented and FDA-registered, that the first bulk commercial order was completed and fulfilled, and the exclusive distribution terms are as stated by the company; no financial terms were disclosed.
brief: TempraMed Technologies has entered a definitive exclusive distribution agreement with TEM Consulting International, a Panama-based healthcare logistics company, to sell its temperature-protection devices through clinics and pharmacies across Panama. The agreement converts a previously announced letter of intent into a binding commercial relationship, and the company said an initial bulk order has been completed.

The products covered are TempraMed's VIVI line — Cap, Cap Smart, Epi and Med — which the company describes as patented, FDA-registered thermal-insulation devices that protect temperature-sensitive medications without batteries or external power. The release names no financial terms, order value or contract length, so the agreement's scale cannot be gauged from the disclosure.

For a micro-cap medical-device issuer, moving a distribution arrangement from letter of intent to a binding deal with a first order shipped is a step from intention to revenue, however modest. Without disclosed figures, the announcement signals commercial progress rather than quantifiable impact, and readers should treat it as a milestone, not a financial result.

entries.headline: GoldCoast reports visible gold in debut Ghana exploration update
entries.dek: In its first update since listing on the CSE, the offshore explorer said coastal samples yielded up to 13 gold grains and an airborne survey covered its full licence.
entries.caption: Offshore placer exploration targets gold grains eroded from land and concentrated in near-shore sediments along a coastline.

sources.title: GoldCoast Resource Corp. Provides Corporate Update

unverified_claims: The 13-grain sampling result, the airborne survey coverage and specifications, the licence dimensions, and the approximately C$10.7 million raised are as reported by the company; no independent mineral resource or reserve estimate exists, as GoldCoast states.
brief: GoldCoast Resource Corp., which began trading on the Canadian Securities Exchange on August 10, has issued its first corporate update. The company reported that preliminary coastal sampling along Ghana's shore recovered as many as 13 visible gold grains from a single five-litre sample, and that a Phase I airborne magnetic survey has covered its full licence area.

The reconnaissance licence spans 10,000 square kilometres over roughly 300 kilometres of Ghana's western coastline, extending about 33 kilometres offshore. The airborne survey, flown at 50 metres by a Cessna 208, maps magnetic anomalies tied to eroded heavy minerals; a 500-square-kilometre priority target at the Ankobra River mouth will be re-flown at tighter spacing.

GoldCoast has raised about C$10.7 million to date. The company states plainly that no mineral resource or reserve has been estimated on any part of the licence, and no economic study completed — a caution worth keeping in view, since visible grains and magnetic anomalies are exploration signals, not measured contained metal.

entries.headline: McFarlane Lake completes 19.9% strategic stake in iMetal
entries.dek: The miner subscribed for 14.2 million units at ten cents apiece, taking a position just below 20% and gaining a board nominee in the Ontario–Quebec explorer.
entries.caption: A junior explorer draws a cornerstone shareholder and a board nominee rather than a broker syndicate to fund its work.

sources.title: McFarlane Lake Announces Completion of Strategic Investment in iMetal Resources, Inc.

unverified_claims: The 14,200,852-unit subscription, $0.10 price, $1,420,085 aggregate and resulting ~19.9% stake, as reported by McFarlane Lake and iMetal.
iMetal's statement that its non-brokered private placement of up to 30,000,000 units is fully subscribed.
The investor rights agreement terms — a board nominee, pro rata participation rights and technical oversight of the Gowganda property — which rest on the companies' own disclosure.
brief: McFarlane Lake Mining has completed its previously announced strategic investment in iMetal Resources, subscribing for 14,200,852 units at $0.10 each for an aggregate $1,420,085. The purchase leaves McFarlane holding roughly 19.9% of iMetal's issued and outstanding common shares, the two companies said.

The units came out of iMetal's non-brokered private placement of up to 30,000,000 units at ten cents, which the explorer has said is fully subscribed. Each unit pairs one common share with one warrant at $0.175 for three years. An investor rights agreement gives McFarlane a board nominee, pro rata participation rights and technical oversight on iMetal's Gowganda property.

A 19.9% position sits just below the 20% threshold that triggers additional Canadian disclosure and takeover-bid mechanics, a common ceiling for strategic holders. For a junior explorer, an anchor investor with technical involvement and a board seat is a different proposition from a passive placement — closer to a partnership than a financing.

entries.headline: Diginex sets October vote on US$1.05bn Resulticks takeover
entries.dek: The Nasdaq-listed firm would issue 600 million shares for the AI marketing company, handing Resulticks holders and a related US$50 million financing about 86% of the combined business between them.
entries.caption: A billion-dollar all-stock combination would hand control of a listed company to the private business it is acquiring.

sources.title: Diginex Limited Announces Extraordinary General Meeting to Approve Proposed Acquisition of Resulticks
Diginex and Resulticks Sign Amended Definitive Agreement to Create a Global AI-Powered Group Spanning Customer Engagement and Trusted Sustainability Data

unverified_claims: The US$1.05 billion valuation, the 600 million-share issuance at US$1.75, Resulticks' FY2025 revenue of US$150 million and after-tax profit of US$17 million, the growth rate above 60%, the approximate 86%/14% ownership split, the US$70 million funding commitments and the October 8 vote and October 30 target close are stated by Diginex and remain subject to shareholder, Nasdaq and regulatory approval.
The reported decline in Diginex's share price on the revised terms is market commentary from third-party reports, not a company disclosure.
brief: Diginex has signed an amended definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Resulticks, a provider of AI-powered customer-engagement software, for approximately US$1.05 billion. The all-share deal would see Diginex issue 600 million new ordinary shares at US$1.75 each. Shareholders are due to vote on the transaction at an October meeting.

Because Resulticks' shareholders and a related US$50 million financing would together hold roughly 86% of the enlarged company, the deal functions as a reverse takeover: the target's owners gain control of the listed vehicle. Existing Diginex holders would be diluted to about 14%. Completion is targeted for October 30, subject to a shareholder vote and Nasdaq approval.

Reverse takeovers let a private company reach public markets through an existing listing rather than an IPO, and the ownership split is the tell: at 86%, Resulticks is the acquirer in substance. Diginex said Resulticks generated US$150 million of revenue and US$17 million of after-tax profit in FY2025, figures a venture reader should treat as company-supplied.

entries.headline: Twenty Mile Metals replaces CEO and CFO after resignations
entries.dek: Thomas Lamb and Ivan Riabov stepped down voluntarily; director Chris Beltgens takes the top job with Rakesh Malhotra as chief financial officer.
entries.caption: A British Columbia mineral explorer names a new chief executive and finance chief after two voluntary resignations.

sources.title: Twenty Mile Metals Names Chris Beltgens as CEO and Rakesh Malhotra as CFO Following Executive Departures

unverified_claims: The resignations of Thomas Lamb and Ivan Riabov, their voluntary nature and stated reason, the appointments of Chris Beltgens and Rakesh Malhotra, and the incoming executives' credentials and prior roles are as described in Twenty Mile Metals' release.
brief: Twenty Mile Metals said Thomas Lamb, its chief executive and a director, and Ivan Riabov, its chief financial officer, have voluntarily resigned, effective immediately, to pursue other business opportunities. The Vancouver-based explorer named director Chris Beltgens as chief executive and Rakesh Malhotra as chief financial officer, both effective at once.

Beltgens, already a board member, brings more than 15 years in the exploration-and-production and mining sector, including corporate-finance roles at GMP Securities Europe and Tristone Capital. Malhotra is a Chartered Professional Accountant with over 30 years of senior financial experience, having served as chief financial officer at Canadian-listed mining and exploration companies.

A simultaneous departure of both the chief executive and chief financial officer is a governance event venture-market readers watch closely, since it can precede a change in strategy or financing posture. The company framed both exits as voluntary and moved to fill the roles the same day, and did not announce any change to its exploration program.

entries.headline: Charlie's Holdings revenue rises 116% as operating loss widens
entries.dek: The vapor products maker booked $3.8 million in second-quarter revenue but its operating loss deepened to $1.2 million as cash fell to $0.5 million.
entries.caption: A fast-growing micro-cap posts triple-digit revenue gains while its cash balance and operating losses pull the other way.

sources.title: Charlie’s Holdings (OTCQB: CHUC) Reports 116% Growth to $3.8 Million Revenue for Q2 2026

unverified_claims: All financial figures are the company's unaudited second-quarter results as reported by Charlie's Holdings.
The attribution of growth to the SBX non-nicotine disposable line, which is the company's characterization.
The FDA's 'non-enforcement prioritization' of 30 PACHA SKUs, as described by the company, which the release itself calls tentative.
brief: Charlie's Holdings reported second-quarter revenue of $3.8 million, up 116% from $1.8 million a year earlier, the vapor and electronic-nicotine products company said. Gross profit rose 130% to $1.1 million, lifting gross margin to 29.4% from 27.6%. Growth was led by the company's SBX non-nicotine disposable line.

The higher revenue did not carry to the bottom line. Charlie's posted an operating loss of $1.2 million for the quarter, wider than the $1.0 million loss a year earlier. Cash fell to $0.5 million from $1.3 million at the end of 2025, while shareholders' equity slipped to $3.1 million from $3.4 million.

Management and directors bought 1,350,000 shares for $270,000 in the first half, insider buying the company disclosed alongside the results. Charlie's also said the FDA tentatively identified 30 of its PACHA products for non-enforcement prioritization — a posture that stops short of marketing authorization but signals lower near-term enforcement risk.

entries.headline: AngloGold Ashanti lifts Thesis Gold stake to 9.7%
entries.dek: The senior producer will subscribe for C$58.5 million of common and flow-through shares in the Toodoggone explorer, nearly doubling a position it first took in February.
entries.caption: A gold-silver exploration project in northern British Columbia draws a fresh injection of strategic capital from a senior producer.

sources.title: Thesis Gold & Silver Announces AngloGold Ashanti to Increase its Strategic Investment through a C$58.5M Offering

unverified_claims: The stake increase from approximately 5% to 9.7%, the three tranche sizes and prices, the total of C$58,462,111, the use of proceeds and the anticipated August 27 closing are stated in Thesis Gold & Silver's release and remain subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.
The company's statement that AngloGold's initial 5% investment was completed in February 2026.
brief: Thesis Gold & Silver said AngloGold Ashanti will increase its strategic investment through a C$58,462,111 offering of common and flow-through shares priced across three tranches. The subscription lifts the senior gold producer's holding in the Toodoggone-district explorer from roughly 5% to 9.7% of shares outstanding.

The offering comprises 8,342,257 common shares at C$3.4118, 2,020,202 British Columbia flow-through shares at C$4.95, and 4,282,655 national flow-through shares at C$4.67. Flow-through proceeds fund Canadian exploration expenses at the 100%-owned Lawyers-Ranch gold-silver project; the balance covers working capital and technical studies. Closing is expected around August 27, subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.

A producer topping up a minority stake rather than bidding for the asset is a pattern venture-market readers track: it funds drilling now while preserving optionality on a fuller transaction later. The four-month hold and an amended investor rights agreement signal a relationship intended to endure past this placement.

entries.headline: Aitenders begins trading on the CSE after reverse takeover
entries.dek: The French tender-software developer received final listing approval and opened under the symbol BIDS, four days after closing its shell transaction with eXeBlock.
entries.caption: The listing completes a reverse takeover of a dormant Canadian shell by a France-based software developer.

sources.title: Aitenders Technologies Commences Trading on Canadian Securities Exchange with Innovative AI Construction Platform

unverified_claims: The description of the platform, and the characterisation of construction as the world's largest and least digitised industry, are the company's own marketing language.
The chief executive's statement that Aitenders was built without raising venture capital before the reverse takeover is the company's account and is not independently verified in the release.
The biographies of incoming directors and officers are as supplied by the company.
The release contains no revenue, customer or share-structure disclosure for the operating business.
brief: Aitenders Technologies Inc. has received final approval to list on the Canadian Securities Exchange and its shares began trading at Monday's open under the symbol BIDS. The listing completes the reverse takeover of eXeBlock Technology Corporation, whose closing and conditional approval were announced on 6 August.

The company sells software for tender response and contract management to construction and infrastructure firms. Management changed at closing, with founder Geoffrey Guilly as chief executive. The release sets out the incoming directors and officers but carries no financial information about the operating business.

A dormant Canadian shell taking a French software company public is the CSE route working as designed: faster and cheaper than a prospectus, at the cost of the disclosure a prospectus would have forced. What the market can price on day one is correspondingly thin.

entries.headline: Eric Sprott to hold 19.5% of MAX Power after $10 million placement
entries.dek: The non-brokered financing prices four million units at $2.50 with a full warrant at $3.25, and lifts his stake to a level that needs a shareholder vote.
entries.caption: Proceeds are directed to commercial validation drilling at the Lawson Complex in southern Saskatchewan.

sources.title: MAX Power Mining (CSE: MAXX; OTC: MAXXF; FRANKFURT: 89N) Secures $10M Strategic Private Placement With Eric Sprott - TradingView

unverified_claims: The post-closing ownership percentages are the company's expectations, stated before the placement has closed.
Closing on or about 17 August is anticipated and remains subject to customary conditions and CSE approval.
The company's intention to rely on the MI 61-101 exemptions rests on its own expectation that the transaction falls below 25% of market capitalisation.
The release states dollar amounts without specifying a currency.
brief: MAX Power Mining has agreed a non-brokered private placement with Eric Sprott for gross proceeds of $10 million. The financing is 4,000,000 units at $2.50, subscribed for by 2176423 Ontario Ltd., a company beneficially owned by Sprott, with closing anticipated on or about 17 August.

Each unit carries one common share and one full warrant exercisable at $3.25 for 24 months. Sprott already holds more than 10% of the shares, making this a related party transaction under MI 61-101; the company intends to rely on exemptions from formal valuation and minority approval on the basis that the size falls under 25% of market capitalisation.

The placement takes him to roughly 19.5% undiluted and 30.5% partially diluted. He has undertaken not to exercise warrants past 19.9% unless shareholders pass a control person resolution at a special meeting on 20 August. Proceeds fund commercial validation drilling at the Lawson Complex in Saskatchewan.

entries.headline: Blue Lagoon's mill and offtake partners buy C$10 million of stock
entries.dek: Nicola Mining and Ocean Partners will each put C$5 million into the Dome Mountain producer at C$0.60 a share, above market and with no warrants attached.
entries.caption: Dome Mountain material is processed under a long-term milling agreement with Nicola Mining, one of the two investors.

sources.title: Nicola Mining and Ocean Partners Invest $10 Million in Blue Lagoon Resources’ Dome Mountain Gold Project Expansion

unverified_claims: The premium of more than 10% to the 20-day volume-weighted average price is the company's own calculation; the release does not show the underlying figure.
Statements about the partners' visibility into the operation and about aligning the Dome Mountain value chain are the company's characterisation, made by its chief executive.

Blue Lagoon states that its production decision at Dome Mountain was not based on a feasibility study of mineral reserves, and that this carries a higher risk of failure. This is the company's own disclosure.
The share count is approximate and subject to rounding, and no closing date is given.
The release does not disclose what percentage of the company either investor will hold after closing.
brief: Blue Lagoon Resources has agreed a C$10 million equity investment from the two companies that process and buy its output. Nicola Mining, which mills Dome Mountain material under a long-term agreement, and Ocean Partners Holdings, which takes the gold and silver offtake, will each subscribe C$5 million at C$0.60 a share.

The shares price at what the company calls a premium of more than 10% to its 20-day volume-weighted average, and carry no warrants — a departure from the venture norm, where a half-warrant sweetener is close to standard. Roughly 16.67 million shares are expected. Closing is subject to CSE policies.

Both buyers already hold stock and both see the mine from the inside: Nicola weighs every tonne milled at Merritt, Ocean Partners handles every ounce sold. Buying at a premium without warrants is a different signal from a discounted raise to generalist funds, though it is not independent validation.

entries.headline: Pinnacle prices $200 million blank-cheque listing with rights, not warrants
entries.dek: The vehicle priced 20 million units at $10.00 for NYSE listing on August 7, each unit carrying a right to one-eighth of a share rather than a warrant.
entries.caption: A newly listed acquisition vehicle holds cash and a deadline, and little else, until it names a target.

sources.title: Pinnacle Acquisition Corporation Announces Pricing of $200 Million Initial Public Offering

unverified_claims: The commencement of trading on August 7, the separate trading of shares and rights, and closing on August 10 are statements of expectation. None had occurred at the time of the release.

The release discloses no trust account amount, sponsor identity, promote structure or combination deadline. Those terms should be confirmed against the registration statement before this vehicle is compared with any other.
The $230 million figure is calculated from the disclosed base offering and the full over-allotment option; the option had not been exercised.
brief: Pinnacle Acquisition Corporation priced an initial public offering of 20,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, for gross proceeds of $200 million. The units were to begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol PNAQ.U on August 7. Santander and CIBC Capital Markets are joint book-running managers, and closing is expected on August 10.

Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-eighth of a share on completion of an initial business combination. The underwriters hold a 45-day option over a further 3,000,000 units. Shares and rights separate no later than the 52nd day, trading as PNAQ and PNAQ.RT.

The release discloses no trust amount, no sponsor and no target sector; the company says it may pursue a combination in any industry. For venture-market readers, the terms a blank-cheque vehicle can raise on at this size frame what a capital pool company or reverse-takeover shell can credibly offer a vendor at the small end.

entries.headline: Autozi signs reverse takeover letter of intent without naming counterparty
entries.dek: The Nasdaq-listed company says a non-binding agreement would combine it with an unidentified private business valued at about $300 million, for a combined company of roughly $320 million.
entries.caption: A letter of intent commits the parties to negotiate, and to very little else, until definitive documents are signed.

sources.title: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. (Nasdaq: AZI) Announces Letter of Intent for Proposed Reverse Takeover Transaction with Privately Held Operating Company

unverified_claims: The $300 million counterparty valuation and the $320 million combined valuation are the company's stated expectations. They are not independently determined or audited figures.
The counterparty is not identified. Its sector, revenue, jurisdiction and ownership are undisclosed, so the valuation cannot be assessed from the release.
The implied residual of roughly 6% for existing Autozi holders is calculated from the two disclosed valuations. The release does not state the consideration or the share issuance mechanics.
The letter of intent is non-binding and the company states there can be no assurance the transaction will be completed.
brief: Autozi Internet Technology (Global) Ltd. said on August 7 that it had entered a non-binding letter of intent contemplating a reverse takeover by a privately held operating company. The counterparty is expected to be valued at approximately $300 million, and the combined company at approximately $320 million.

The counterparty's identity and the commercial terms remain confidential pending due diligence and definitive documentation. Completion is subject to financing arrangements and to board, shareholder and regulatory approvals. Autozi's existing Nasdaq listing is expected to continue, and the company is targeting completion before year end.

The arithmetic does most of the work. A $300 million counterparty inside a $320 million combined company implies the existing business accounts for a small minority of the result. That is the defining feature of a reverse takeover, disclosed here at letter-of-intent stage with no name attached to it.

entries.headline: PyroGenesis revenue rises 47% as cash falls to $1.3 million
entries.dek: Second-quarter revenue reached $4.4 million and the net loss narrowed to $1.1 million, but the company closed the quarter with a $7.1 million working capital deficiency.
entries.caption: Order books of this size are won years before they are delivered, and delivery has to be funded in the interval.

sources.title: PyroGenesis Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results: Revenue of $4.4 Million, Up 47% Year-Over-Year for Best Q2 Since 2022

unverified_claims: The characterisation of the quarter as the company's best second quarter since 2022, and the commentary on demand for metal powders, are the company's own statements.

The release states first-half capital raised of $6.26 million, which does not reconcile with the three financings it itemises ($1.97 million, $4.26 million and $2.0 million). Confirm against the interim financial statements before using either figure.
Modified EBITDA is a non-IFRS measure defined by the company and is not comparable across issuers.
The $40.0 million backlog is a company-reported figure covering signed and awarded contracts; awarded work is not necessarily contracted revenue.
brief: PyroGenesis Inc. reported second-quarter revenue of $4.4 million, up 47% from a year earlier, at a 32% gross margin. The net loss narrowed to $1.1 million from $2.9 million, and the modified EBITDA loss to $0.5 million from $2.1 million. Six-month revenue was $9.3 million against $6.0 million.

Growth came from SPARC refrigerant destruction, at $1.06 million against $0.33 million, and DROSRITE dross recovery, at $0.60 million against $0.13 million. Torch-related sales rose to $1.59 million. Biogas upgrading and PUREVAP silicon fell. Signed and awarded contracts stood at $40.0 million, 88% denominated in US dollars.

The balance sheet is the constraint. Cash was $1.3 million at June 30 against a $7.1 million working capital deficiency, after three financings in the first half. A book of that size converts only as fast as working capital allows, and management again declined to give revenue guidance.

entries.headline: Pacific Booker receives final approval and funds on $4 million placement
entries.dek: The TSX Venture Exchange signed off on a 1,860,466-unit financing priced at $2.15, with proceeds earmarked for an updated resource estimate and a pre-feasibility study at the Morrison project.
entries.caption: Pre-feasibility work turns a deposit into a costing exercise, and costing exercises are settled in offices rather than in the field.

sources.title: Pacific Booker Minerals Inc. Announces Final TSX Venture Approval and Receipt of Funds on Non-Brokered Private Placement

unverified_claims: The Technical Advisory Board's conclusion that sufficient technical information exists to advance the project to the pre-feasibility stage is the company's own statement.

The use-of-proceeds allocation is the company's stated intention. No budget, timetable or split between workstreams is disclosed, and there is no indication whether the $4.0 million funds the pre-feasibility study to completion.
Permitting is listed as a use of proceeds; the release gives no permitting status for the project. Confirm independently before drawing any inference from the line item.
Terms of the placement are taken from the company's July 16, 2026 release. The August 5 release confirms final approval and receipt of funds without restating them.
brief: Pacific Booker Minerals said on August 5 that it had received final approval from the TSX Venture Exchange, and all proceeds, in connection with the non-brokered private placement whose terms it disclosed on July 16. The financing raised gross proceeds of $4,000,001.90 through 1,860,466 units priced at $2.15.

Each unit comprises one common share and one warrant exercisable at $2.37 for 36 months from closing. Finder's fees of $15,824 in cash and 7,360 broker warrants were payable. A director of the company subscribed for 46,512 units at the offering price. The securities carry a four-month-and-one-day hold.

Proceeds are directed at the Morrison project: an updated mineral resource estimate, an NI 43-101 pre-feasibility study, geological and environmental programs, permitting and working capital. Funding a study rather than further drilling is a statement about where a project sits in its life — the stage at which a resource is tested against costs rather than geology.

entries.headline: Biomind Labs moves from Cboe Canada to the CSE
entries.dek: The clinical-stage drug developer begins trading on the Canadian Securities Exchange on August 11 under BMND, delisting from Cboe Canada the previous evening after five years.
entries.caption: A change of listing venue leaves the shares untouched and changes the rules the issuer answers to.

sources.title: Biomind Labs Announces Listing on the Canadian Securities Exchange and the Delisting From the Cboe Canada

unverified_claims: The cease trade order history is taken from Biomind's separate release dated November 25, 2025. The August 6, 2026 listing release does not mention it, and the company has not linked the two events.
The stated rationale for the venue change is the company's own. It gives no operational, cost or regulatory reason for leaving Cboe Canada.
The OTC Pink symbol BMNDF is taken from the November 2025 release rather than the listing release. Confirm it remains current after the CSE listing.
The listing and delisting dates are scheduled events as at the date of the release, not completed ones.
brief: Biomind Labs Inc. said on August 6 that it had received approval to list its common shares on the Canadian Securities Exchange, with trading to begin at the open on August 11 under the symbol BMND. The shares are to be delisted from Cboe Canada at the close of business on August 10.

No shareholder action is required and the company's OTC Pink listing is unaffected. Biomind described the CSE listing as offering opportunities to investors as it continues to develop its operations, and thanked Cboe Canada for five years of support. It is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company working on central nervous system conditions.

A voluntary move between Canadian venues is rarely only about liquidity. The relevant context sits in a separate release: the Ontario Securities Commission cease traded the company in April 2025 for failing to file its 2024 audited statements, and revoked the order in November 2025 once the filings were made.
